engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Telematic Emergency Battery fault
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Telematic Emergency Battery
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Telematic Emergency Battery
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi A4 (8E): Telematics, the Telematics Service (Provider) was discontinued as of 30/Nov/2007. For functionality and cost reasons it may not be advisable to Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the Emergency Battery but to deactivated the Telematic Functions instead. In this context please see TPI 1545801, 1623601 and 2001922.
